Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: (1d1) piercing damage plus (1d4) poison damage. The target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take the poison damage.

The adder attacks with its Bite.
The bat can't use its blindsight while deafened.
The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.
The bat doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d1) piercing damage.

The bat attacks with its Bite.
The cat can follow or patrol for a specific target. When doing so, it has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
The cat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d1) slashing damage.

The cat makes an attack with its claws.
The goliath tarantula can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
While in contact with a web, the goliath tarantula knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
The goliath tarantula ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d1) piercing damage.

The goliath tarantula attacks with its Bite.
A very small burst of fire may come out of the firecrab's rear end, which ignites flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried.
The firecrab can hold its breath for 1 hour.

Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d1) slashing damage.

The firecrab makes an attack with its claws.
The owl doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.
The owl has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or hearing.
When given a note, letter, or package, the owl will magically know the location of the recipient and fly to deliver the letter.
The puffskein appears to be a living ball of fluff; its cuteness might be distracting to some, much like carrying around an adorable kitten.
The puffskein has a disproportionately long tongue that it can use to grab or manipulate small objects.
The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

Melee Weapon Attack:+4 to hit,, 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d1) piercing damage.

The Rat attacks with its Bite.

Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: (1d1) piercing damage.

The snake attacks with its Bite.
The toad can breathe air and water.
The toad's long jump is up to 10 ft. and its high jump is up to 5 ft., with or without a running start.
